snippet.title: Lava Golf - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a new and unexpected take on golf games! In Lava Golf you do not control the golfer, instead you are the golf ball and your objective is to cross all rings to reach the end portal of each course and escape. Unlock unique skills, cross all the rings, and most importantly... DO NOT FALL INTO THE LAVA!

Lava Golf opens its infernal courses on PC 25 May 2021. 

For more Lava Golf follow us on these sites:

Itch.io Lava Golf page - https://artanisx.itch.io/lava-golf

Twitter - https://twitter.com/GolfLava

Website - https://artanisx.github.io/LavaGolf/

#LavaGolf #HexagonalExperiencesInc #OfficialTrailer #Launch #Trailer

Music: "I Can't Stop" by Punch Deck
